items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: this job I was supposed to get, he gave it to Cab Calloway. Cab Calloway got that job.

ctx.x: At the Yankee Stadium so he could dance on the dugout and everything you see? So man, I had a nice group out there you see. And so old Bill Robinson, it looked like he wasn't going to pay me for that you know? On the strength that he was taking me out on the road you see?

So man, I found that cat up in the office in the Yankee Stadium. And he said, nigger let me know what you want? I said, 'I want to get paid for today.' I said 'I've got a lot of good men out there.' I said, 'now me, I don't care if you pay me or not.' I said, 'but you've got to pay the other guys, see?'
